pre_command: rm -f ~/Desktop/Project_File_List.txt && mkdir -p ~/Desktop/Projects && echo "Sample document content" > ~/Desktop/Projects/sample.txt && echo "Project notes and details" > ~/Desktop/Projects/project_notes.md && echo "Configuration settings" > ~/Desktop/Projects/config.json && echo "Main application code" > ~/Desktop/Projects/main.py && echo "Stylesheet definitions" > ~/Desktop/Projects/styles.css && echo "README documentation" > ~/Desktop/Projects/README.md && mkdir -p ~/Desktop/Projects/subfolder && echo "Nested file content" > ~/Desktop/Projects/subfolder/nested_file.log && echo "Database backup" > ~/Desktop/Projects/subfolder/backup.sql && osascript -e 'tell application "Automator" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Desktop/Project_File_List.txt
instruction: Create an Automator workflow that scans all files in the '~/Desktop/Projects' folder and writes a list of their filenames into a new text file called 'Project_File_List.txt' saved on the Desktop.
evaluator: [ -f ~/Desktop/Project_File_List.txt ] && [ -s ~/Desktop/Project_File_List.txt ] && [ -d ~/Desktop/Projects ] && PROJECT_COUNT=$(find ~/Desktop/Projects -type f | wc -l) && LIST_COUNT=$(grep -c . ~/Desktop/Project_File_List.txt) && [ $PROJECT_COUNT -eq $LIST_COUNT ] && echo True || echo False
